correctness.rationale: Every element of E is 3-divisible because each even one-run contributes 2^h(2^(2j)-1). The converse is an exact complete finite-state proof: a three-bit addition state tracks parity for both currently open one-runs and the carry. Digit transitions close only even runs and enforce correct binary sum bits. An exhaustive BFS of the product determinization, modulo-three residue and next-digit parity has exactly ten reachable configurations, listed in RESULT.md; all and only residue-zero configurations contain the accepting state (0,0,0). Closure verifies all possible word lengths. The verifier recomputes each transition from input digits and checks all ten states independently of a numerical cutoff; direct tests below 16384 are supplemental.

originality.rationale: The exact equality E+E=3N and its minimal order-two consequence are not stated in the closely matched primary literature inspected. The 2023 paper supplies the run-length support criterion; the 2017 automatic-basis paper supplies general decidability but no evaluation of this set; the 2003 special-sequence study treats parity of the total number of zeros rather than even one-run lengths. A complete ten-configuration certificate supplies the new exact calculation. Unindexed earlier equivalent formulations remain possible, so this is not a certification of absolute priority.

value.rationale: The support of a natural generalized Baum–Sweet type 2-automatic sequence is highly restricted, but after dividing by three it is an exact additive basis of minimal order two. Complete sharp sumset coverage is mathematically stronger than nonemptiness, decidability, density estimates or finite enumeration. The ten-state carry certificate exposes a concrete structural additive property of the 2023 binary-run object and could guide generalizations to other run-length constraints; no speculative downstream theorem is assumed.
